description: Objective: make PR #3549 (`fix/windows-antipattern-posix-rules`) pass CI and satisfy solution-fit (`[REVIEW-FIT-001]`) with a zero-baseline check and fast pre-commit hook. Review findings on #3549 (`fedd9e024`): (1) CI blocker: `quality/windows-antipatterns-baseline.json` fails `check_doc_reference_inventory` across `lint`, `test`, `example-validation`, `docs`, and `core`, and already conflicts with PR #3545. (2) Solution-fit defect (`[REVIEW-FIT-001]`): WA007 (`git` with `text=True` and no `encoding`) seeded 215 baseline entries (~102 `git rev-parse`, ~154 ASCII test repos) by bypassing `--write-baseline`'s ratchet refusal; because stale counts also fail, every future edit touching any of the 215 sites must update the shared baseline JSON. Either drop WA007 (since `ci-windows-fcntl-and-git-utf8-fixes-20261026` fixes the 4 real `git -z`/`git show` sites) or narrow WA007 strictly to `git` commands passing `-z` with zero baseline entries. (3) Coverage & precision defects: `_DEFAULT_ROOTS` in `scripts/check_windows_antipatterns.py` omits `_project/`, so WA005 misses `_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/local.py:5` and `_project/sql-translation-ml/conftest.py:1`; WA004 flags git diff header comparisons (`--- /dev/null`, `+++ /dev/null`) and `sys.platform != 'win32'` guarded branches; WA006 only checks inline dict literals `env={...}`, missing local variable dicts `env=environment` (`test_module_state_guard.py:46-52`). (4) Hook performance: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` sets `pass_filenames: false`, adding an ~11 s full-tree AST scan to every `.py` commit. Prior art: modifies PR #3549 (`scripts/check_windows_antipatterns.py`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `tests/unit/scripts/test_check_windows_antipatterns.py`).
